title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
title_zh: TerraVis：通过 MLLM 工作流评估文本到图像生成中基于现实世界视觉一致性的方法

paragraphs.en: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis , a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis .

paragraphs.en: Generative models, especially text-to-image generation models, have made remarkable progress in recent years. From earlier generative adversarial network (GAN)-based models [ 11 , 1 , 24 , 63 , 19 , 3 , 60 ] , to diffusion-based models [ 16 , 8 , 40 , 18 , 34 , 38 , 41 ] , and more recently autoregressive-based models [ 39 , 58 , 48 , 51 , 53 , 51 , 13 , 7 ] and diffusion-autoregressive hybrid models [ 62 , 45 , 4 ] , their ability to synthesize increasingly realistic imagery has advanced substantially. This progress has been accompanied by the development of a rich ecosystem of evaluation metrics. These span distributional similarity metrics such as Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 15 ] , text-image alignment metrics such as CLIPScore [ 14 ] , human preference scores such as ImageReward [ 56 ] , as well as technical quality metrics [ 32 , 31 , 20 ] and aesthetic quality metrics [ 33 , 44 , 50 ] . By providing quantitative signals along these dimensions, existing metrics have served as important optimization objectives and evaluation references, encouraging progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and alignment with user prompts.

paragraphs.en: However, existing evaluation metrics are not designed to directly assess whether a generated image is visually consistent with the real-world referent it attempts to depict. For example, a generated image may achieve a high level of photorealism, strong text-image alignment, or favorable human preference scores, while still containing implausible object structures, physically implausible interactions, impossible spatial relationships, or other world-level visual errors. Such failures can undermine the reliability of generated images in applications where visual content is expected to represent a physically plausible and trustworthy depiction of the world. We argue that a key reason this gap persists is the absence of an evaluation metric that explicitly targets this dimension.

paragraphs.en: Building on this concept, we propose TerraVis , a systematic evaluation framework for detecting and scoring world-grounded visual inconsistencies in generated images. TerraVis first defines a fine-grained and structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations, covering common object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures. It then leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in a sequential workflow that checks evaluation eligibility, detects taxonomy-guided violations, classifies their severity, and aggregates the resulting major and minor violations into an overall score using a negative exponential function. Experimental results show that TerraVis achieves stronger correlation with human judgments than TerraVis-H , a holistic MLLM baseline that is prompted with the same taxonomy descriptions and evaluation instructions provided to human annotators. This demonstrates the advantage of decomposing world-consistency evaluation through taxonomy guidance and a multi-stage MLLM workflow. Ablation results further show that our severity-aware exponential aggregation outperforms uniform checklist-style pass-rate aggregation, which treats all items equally and is commonly adopted in prior QA-based evaluation methods [ 17 , 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一概念，我们提出了 TerraVis——一个用于检测并评分生成图像中与世界现实相关的视觉不一致性的系统性评估框架。 TerraVis 首先定义了一个精细且结构化的世界一致性违反分类体系，涵盖了常见的物体、交互和场景层面的问题。 随后，它通过一个顺序工作流程利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）：首先检查评估资格，接着检测由分类体系指导的违反项，对其严重程度进行分类，最后使用负指数函数将主要和次要违反项汇总为总体得分。 实验结果表明，TerraVis 与人类判断的相关性优于 TerraVis-H——一个整体性的 MLLM 基线模型，该模型使用了与人类标注者相同的分类体系描述和评估指令。 这证明了通过分类体系指导和多阶段 MLLM 工作流程来分解世界一致性评估的优势。 消融实验结果进一步表明，我们提出的考虑严重程度的指数汇总方法优于均匀的检查清单式通过率汇总方法——后者将所有条目视为同等重要，且常见于以往的基于问答的评估方法 [17, 5]。

paragraphs.en: We introduce world-grounded visual consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension for text-to-image generation, focusing on perceptible violations of real-world structural, spatial, biological, and physical constraints.

paragraphs.en: We benchmark TerraVis against existing quality, alignment, and preference metrics across multiple text-to-image models and datasets, showing substantially stronger correlation with human judgments of world consistency.

paragraphs.en: Image-text alignment metrics have been widely used to evaluate text-to-image models [ 14 , 17 , 6 , 29 , 5 , 22 , 28 ] . For example, CLIPScore [ 14 ] is originally proposed to measure the semantic similarity between text prompts and generated images. TIFA [ 17 ] decomposes a text prompt into multiple question-answer pairs using large language models (LLMs), enabling a more fine-grained evaluation of text-to-image alignment. VQAScore adopts a simpler approach by deriving an alignment score from the probability of the “Yes" token under a fixed text-image alignment template.

paragraphs.en: Recently, a growing number of human preference scores have been proposed to better align the outputs of text-to-image models with human preferences [ 56 , 21 , 55 , 54 , 61 , 30 ] . Unlike image-text alignment metrics, these methods aim to capture how well a generated image matches human judgments of overall quality and preference. Representative examples include ImageReward [ 56 ] , PickScore [ 21 ] , and the Human Preference Score (HPS) series [ 55 , 54 , 30 ] , which are typically trained on large-scale human preference data. As a result, they provide a complementary perspective that goes beyond traditional text-image semantic alignment metrics.

paragraphs.en: This section presents our definition of world-grounded visual consistency in generated images and describes how TerraVis evaluates it through a carefully designed protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 本节提出了我们对生成图像中世界相关视觉一致性的定义，并描述了 TerraVis 如何通过精心设计的协议对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: General definition. World-grounded visual consistency (hereafter, world consistency ) measures the extent to which a representational depiction of an macroscopic object or scene visually conforms to real-world constraints. These constraints include, for example, plausible object structure and anatomy, valid text or symbolic content when present, physically plausible interactions and environmental effects, spatially plausible scale, depth ordering, and continuity, as well as commonsense compatibility between objects, actions, events, and scene context.
paragraphs.zh: 一般定义。 基于现实世界的视觉一致性（下文称为“世界一致性”）衡量的是对宏观物体或场景的具象描绘在视觉上符合现实世界约束的程度。 这些约束包括，例如，合理的物体结构和解剖特征、存在时的有效文本或符号内容、物理上可信的相互作用和环境效应、空间上合理的尺度、深度排序和连续性，以及物体、动作、事件与场景背景之间的常识兼容性。

sents.en: General definition.
sents.zh: 一般定义。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation scope. World consistency is not tied to photorealism, so it can also be assessed in stylized images such as cartoons and sketches, provided they depict identifiable real-world objects or scenes with sufficient visual structure to support plausibility judgments. However, the following content types are excluded: purely abstract content (e.g., color blocks and geometric patterns); symbolic content (e.g., logos, icons, emblems, flags, and emojis); informational content (e.g., charts, diagrams, maps, and tables); interface content (e.g., UI mockups and app/website screenshots); layout-based compositions (e.g., posters, advertisements, book covers, collages, multi-panel layouts); and microscopic content (e.g., cell structures, fabric fibers, and material surfaces). These categories are excluded because they do not depict content depicting macroscopic objects or scenes to which world-consistency constraints can be meaningfully applied.
paragraphs.zh: 评估范围。 世界一致性并不依赖于照片级真实感，因此也可以对风格化的图像（如卡通和草图）进行评估，前提是其描绘了具有足够视觉结构、能够支持合理性判断的可识别现实世界物体或场景。 然而，以下内容类型被排除在外：纯粹抽象内容（例如色块和几何图案）；象征性内容（例如徽标、图标、标志、旗帜和表情符号）；信息性内容（例如图表、示意图、地图和表格）；界面内容（例如用户界面原型以及应用程序/网站截图）；基于布局的构图（例如海报、广告、书籍封面、拼贴画和多面板布局）；以及微观内容（例如细胞结构、织物纤维和材料表面）。 这些类别被排除在外，因为它们并未描绘能够有意义地应用世界一致性约束的宏观物体或场景。

paragraphs.en: Style-tolerant but world-constrained. Stylistic rendering choices that intentionally reduce photorealism, such as simplified texture, flattened color, schematic lighting, or attenuated high-frequency detail, do not in themselves constitute world-consistency violations. A violation arises only when stylized content contradicts fundamental real-world constraints, rather than merely departing from photorealistic appearance. For instance, if a person’s hand interpenetrates a cup they are shown holding, this constitutes a world-consistency violation regardless of image style, because it violates the physical integrity of the depicted objects.
paragraphs.zh: 风格上具有容错性，但受限于现实世界。 有意降低照片真实感的风格化呈现选择（例如简化纹理、扁平化色彩、示意性光照或削弱高频细节），本身并不构成对世界一致性的违背。 只有当风格化的内容与现实世界的基本约束相矛盾时，才会构成违背，而不仅仅是偏离照片般逼真的外观。 例如，如果一个人的手穿透了他们手中拿着的杯子，那么无论图像风格如何，这都构成了对世界一致性的违背，因为它违反了所描绘物体的物理完整性。

paragraphs.en: Existing text-to-image evaluation dimensions, such as aesthetics [ 26 ] , fidelity [ 15 , 36 ] , alignment [ 56 , 36 , 17 , 28 ] , and human preference [ 55 , 54 , 30 ] , are commonly formulated as holistic or aggregate image-level assessments. However, it remains unclear whether evaluating world consistency benefits from a more structured evaluation process. Unlike text-image alignment, which primarily assesses whether the generated content matches the textual prompt, world consistency concerns the intrinsic plausibility of the depicted world, including object structures, spatial layouts, physical interactions, and whether the scene conforms to real-world constraints. To investigate this, we conducted a pilot annotation study with human volunteers under our task definition of world consistency. The study suggests that human judgments naturally follow four recurring stages: eligibility checking, violation detection, severity assessment, and score assignment.

paragraphs.en: Step 1: Eligibility checking. Given an input image I I , TerraVis first determines whether the image falls within the evaluation scope. Specifically, the image is considered eligible only if it depicts a macroscopic object or scene with an intended real-world referent. Images that do not satisfy this condition, such as purely abstract, symbolic, informational, interface-based, layout-based, or microscopic content, are excluded from evaluation and assigned N / A \mathrm{N/A} , following the scope definition in Section 3.1 . paragraphs.en: MLLM workflows. We leverage MLLMs to instantiate eligibility checking, violation detection, and severity classification as a sequence of targeted visual question-answering steps. Rather than prompting MLLMs to directly assign a holistic score of world-consistency, TerraVis decomposes the evaluation into targeted atomic questions at each stage, thereby constraining the output space and reducing open-ended model hallucination. Prompting details for each judgment stage are provided in Appendix B . This structured execution provides interpretable evidence for each decision and improves alignment with holistic human scores, suggesting that the decomposition captures the visual cues humans rely on when judging world consistency.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we instantiate violation detection with two MLLM-based variants: a holistic variant, TerraVis-H , and a workflow-based variant, TerraVis . TerraVis-H directly prompts the MLLM with the same taxonomy descriptions and evaluation instructions provided to human annotators, without decomposing the evaluation process. In contrast, TerraVis uses the MLLM to execute the sequential workflow defined in Algorithm 1 , including eligibility checking, taxonomy-guided violation detection, severity classification, and severity-aware exponential score aggregation.

paragraphs.en: Human annotation design. To evaluate whether TerraVis aligns with human judgments, we collect human reference scores using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) and measure their correlation with TerraVis scores. Following prior studies [ 26 , 36 , 17 , 28 ] , annotators are asked to rate each image on a 5-point Likert scale, with an additional N/A option, based on the presence and severity of perceptible world-consistency violations. Each image is annotated by three independent annotators. The annotation details are provided in Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image benchmarks. Although image-level world-consistency evaluation is inherently prompt-independent, comprehensive benchmarking still requires diverse generated samples to ensure broad scenario coverage. We therefore use prompts from two widely used text-to-image benchmarks, COCO-T2I [ 57 ] with 200 prompts and GenAI-Bench [ 25 ] with 1,600 prompts, to evaluate TerraVis alongside existing metrics on world consistency.

paragraphs.en: Baseline metrics. We compare TerraVis with six representative text-to-image evaluation metrics: MUSIQ, LAION-Aesthetic, CLIPScore, VQAScore, ImageReward, and HPSv3. For reproducibility, MUSIQ is evaluated with the KonIQ checkpoint [ 20 ] ; LAION-Aesthetic uses Aesthetic Predictor V2.5 [ 50 ] , which consists of a pretrained SigLIP image encoder [ 59 ] and the released MLP regression head; CLIPScore [ 14 ] uses the SigLIP2 checkpoint [ 49 ] ; For TIFA [ 17 ] , we use Gemma 4 31B [ 47 ] to generate QA pairs from prompts and perform visual question answering; and VQAScore [ 28 ] computes the “yes”-token probability using Qwen-3.5 [ 37 ] . ImageReward [ 56 ] , RAHF [ 26 ] and HPSv3 [ 30 ] are evaluated using their official released checkpoints. We also include GPTScore as an MLLM-based baseline, where the MLLM is given only the generated image and asked: “ Please rate the world consistency of this image using an integer score from 1 to 5, where 1 indicates severe world-consistency errors and 5 indicates no noticeable world-consistency errors. ” These baselines span image quality, alignment, human preference, and holistic MLLM judgment, enabling us to test whether existing metrics can reliably capture world-consistency errors.

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. We exclude generated images that are not applicable (i.e., N/A images) to world-consistency evaluation, where applicability is determined from the generated image itself rather than inferred from the text-guided prompt. These cases are rare: on average across the evaluated text-to-image models, less than 1% of GenAI-Bench samples are out of scope for world-consistency assessment. All experiments are conducted using the GPT-5.5 API [ 43 ] with default generation parameters. To improve efficiency, we use the Batch API to parallelize all stage-wise QA calls. We preserve each text-to-image model’s stylistic choices under the given prompt, so the evaluated images include both photorealistic outputs and a small number of stylized generations. For human annotation, we annotate a randomly selected 50% subset of the generated images and use this subset for correlation analysis between automatic metrics and human judgments. We set λ \lambda and α \alpha in Eq. ( 1 ) as 1 and 0.5, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Existing metrics are not reliable indicators of world consistency. Table 2 reports the correlations between automatic metrics and human judgments of world consistency. Existing metrics show highly model-dependent agreement with human judgments, as illustrated by the near-zero or negative correlations for TIFA on SD 3.5-Large and HPSv3 on Nano Banana Pro across both benchmarks. GPTScore also exhibits near-zero correlations, assigning almost uniformly high scores to generated images. Among existing metrics, RAHF achieves the strongest correlations ( ρ = 0.29 \rho=0.29 on COCO-T2I and 0.37 0.37 on GenAI-Bench). This may reflect its plausibility dimension, which partially overlaps with TerraVis in detecting violations such as structural distortions. However, TerraVis outperforms all existing metrics by large margins on both benchmarks. These findings suggest that existing quality, alignment, and preference metrics provide only partial and inconsistent signals of world consistency.

paragraphs.en: Structured world-consistency evaluation improves agreement with humans. As shown in Table 2 , TerraVis consistently achieves stronger correlations with human judgments than TerraVis-H. For example, on COCO-T2I, the correlation improves from TerraVis-H ( ρ = 0.28 \rho=0.28 , τ = 0.24 \tau=0.24 ) to TerraVis ( ρ = 0.44 \rho=0.44 , τ = 0.37 \tau=0.37 ). Violation detection analysis provides further insight into this improvement: TerraVis-H exhibits high precision but low recall, whereas TerraVis substantially improves recall while maintaining high precision (see Appendix D.1 for detailed results). Together, these findings suggest that decomposing evaluation into eligibility checking, taxonomy-guided violation detection, severity classification, and severity-aware aggregation provides a more reliable approximation of human judgments than a holistic MLLM assessment.

paragraphs.en: Can TerraVis evaluate stylized images? Yes. To examine TerraVis’s applicability to stylized imagery, we use SigLIP-so400m [ 59 ] to partition the evaluation images into photorealistic and stylized subsets. paragraphs.en: How robust is TerraVis to the choice of MLLM evaluators? TerraVis maintains comparable correlations with human judgments and largely consistent T2I model rankings when GPT-5.5 is replaced with Gemma 4 31B. To assess TerraVis’s robustness to evaluator choice, we rerun it with four additional open-source MLLMs spanning dense and MoE architectures, assessing both correlations with human judgments (Table 3 ) and agreement among the resulting T2I model rankings (Table A4 ). Gemma 4 31B achieves a Spearman correlation comparable to that of GPT-5.5 on COCO-T2I ( ρ = 0.42 \rho=0.42 vs. 0.44 0.44 ) and a higher correlation on GenAI-Bench ( ρ = 0.51 \rho=0.51 vs. 0.43 0.43 ). For T2I model rankings, the mean pairwise Kendall’s τ \tau across all five evaluators is 0.62 0.62 on COCO-T2I and 0.64 0.64 on GenAI-Bench. However, GPT-5.5 and Gemma 4 31B show strong ranking agreement ( τ = 0.80 \tau=0.80 on both benchmarks), while the remaining three evaluators also agree closely with one another (mean pairwise τ = 0.87 \tau=0.87 ). These results indicate stronger ranking agreement within the two evaluator groups than between them. Together, the correlation and ranking results support Gemma 4 31B as an effective open-source alternative to GPT-5.5 for TerraVis evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We benchmark five text-to-image models (three open-source and two proprietary) across technical quality, aesthetics, text-image alignment, human preference, and world consistency. As shown in Figure 3 , GPT Image 1.5 ranks first in 9 of 16 comparisons across both benchmarks, including 8 of 12 on conventional metrics. On COCO-T2I, GPT Image 1.5 achieves the best mean rank across all eight metrics (1.38), followed by Nano Banana Pro (2.75), FLUX.2-dev (3.00), Qwen-Image (3.88), and SD 3.5-Large (4.00). Notably, FLUX.2-dev ranks first in world consistency on GenAI-Bench according to both TerraVis and human judgments, ahead of both proprietary models. A simple qualitative inspection suggests that FLUX.2-dev often generates simpler scenes than the proprietary models, potentially reducing the risk of world-consistency violations. These findings suggest that visual richness and strong conventional performance do not necessarily imply better world consistency, highlighting its value as a complementary evaluation dimension.

paragraphs.en: Although TerraVis achieves stronger correlations with human judgments of world consistency than existing automatic metrics, several limitations remain. First , its multi-stage workflow makes TerraVis less efficient than single-pass scoring metrics (see Appendix D.5 ). Second , violation detection performance remains a potential bottleneck. As discussed in Section 4.5 , TerraVis may produce false positives or miss genuine violations. However, our preliminary results suggest that in-context learning with representative violation examples can improve detection performance, supporting data-centric refinement as a promising direction for future work. Third , although the taxonomy and prompting strategies were developed through iterative refinement combining principled design with data-driven validation, the taxonomy may not cover all forms of world-consistency violations in practice. Continued refinement of the taxonomy and associated prompts may therefore be needed as T2I models evolve. Finally , the benchmark relies on human annotations as its reference. Judgments of ambiguous cases and violation severity may vary across annotators, introducing uncertainty into the measured agreement between automatic metrics and human judgments.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduce world consistency as a new perspective for text-to-image evaluation. We propose TerraVis, a taxonomy-guided MLLM workflow that performs eligibility checking, violation detection, severity classification, and severity-aware aggregation. To validate TerraVis, we collect over 13K human annotations across two benchmarks and five text-to-image models. Experiments on COCO-T2I and GenAI-Bench show that TerraVis achieves the strongest agreement with human judgments, outperforming existing quality, alignment, and preference metrics. This work demonstrates the need to evaluate not only visual appealing or text-image alignment, but also whether generated images visually conform to real-world constraints. We hope this work helps establish world consistency as a core evaluation dimension for future text-to-image models.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将世界一致性引入文本到图像评估的新视角。 我们提出了 TerraVis，这是一种基于分类法指导的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）工作流程，能够执行资格检查、违规检测、严重程度分类以及基于严重程度的聚合分析。 为了验证 TerraVis，我们在两个基准数据集和五种文本到图像模型上收集了超过 1.3 万条人类标注数据。 在 COCO-T2I 和 GenAI-Bench 上的实验表明，TerraVis 与人类判断的一致性最强，优于现有的质量、对齐和偏好度指标。 这项工作表明，评估不仅需要关注视觉吸引力或文本与图像的对齐程度，还需要考察生成的图像是否在视觉上符合现实世界的约束条件。 我们希望这项工作有助于将世界一致性确立为未来文本到图像模型的核心评估维度之一。

sents.en: Experiments on COCO-T2I and GenAI-Bench show that TerraVis achieves the strongest agreement with human judgments, outperforming existing quality, alignment, and preference metrics.
sents.zh: 在 COCO-T2I 和 GenAI-Bench 上的实验表明，TerraVis 与人类判断的一致性最强，优于现有的质量、对齐和偏好度指标。

sents.en: This work demonstrates the need to evaluate not only visual appealing or text-image alignment, but also whether generated images visually conform to real-world constraints.
sents.zh: 这项工作表明，评估不仅需要关注视觉吸引力或文本与图像的对齐程度，还需要考察生成的图像是否在视觉上符合现实世界的约束条件。

sents.en: We hope this work helps establish world consistency as a core evaluation dimension for future text-to-image models.
sents.zh: 我们希望这项工作有助于将世界一致性确立为未来文本到图像模型的核心评估维度之一。

paragraphs.en: Object-level. At the object level, the general standard is that objects and symbolic content should appear valid in the real world and be contextually appropriate for the depicted scene. This level captures whether individual entities are plausible in themselves, independent of broader scene dynamics or inter-object relationships. Specifically, for stylized content, we do not penalize stylistic simplifications in texture/surface appearance, high-frequency detail, or color complexity, as long as the object’s identity and basic structure remain recognizable. Under this level, we define seven specific object-level violation types:
paragraphs.zh: 对象层级。 在对象层级，通用标准是：对象和符号内容应呈现为真实世界中有效的存在，并且与所描绘的场景在语境上相匹配。 该层级用于判断单个实体本身是否合理，而不受更广泛场景动态或对象间关系的影响。 具体而言，对于风格化的内容，只要对象的身份和基本结构仍然可识别，我们不会因纹理/表面外观、高频细节或色彩复杂度的风格化简化而扣分。 在该层级下，我们定义了七种具体的对象层级违规类型：

sents.en: Object-level.
sents.zh: 对象层级。

sents.en: At the object level, the general standard is that objects and symbolic content should appear valid in the real world and be contextually appropriate for the depicted scene.
sents.zh: 在对象层级，通用标准是：对象和符号内容应呈现为真实世界中有效的存在，并且与所描绘的场景在语境上相匹配。

sents.en: This level captures whether individual entities are plausible in themselves, independent of broader scene dynamics or inter-object relationships.
sents.zh: 该层级用于判断单个实体本身是否合理，而不受更广泛场景动态或对象间关系的影响。

sents.en: Specifically, for stylized content, we do not penalize stylistic simplifications in texture/surface appearance, high-frequency detail, or color complexity, as long as the object’s identity and basic structure remain recognizable.
sents.zh: 具体而言，对于风格化的内容，只要对象的身份和基本结构仍然可识别，我们不会因纹理/表面外观、高频细节或色彩复杂度的风格化简化而扣分。

sents.en: Under this level, we define seven specific object-level violation types:
sents.zh: 在该层级下，我们定义了七种具体的对象层级违规类型：

paragraphs.en: Object identity violations : the presence of fictional or fantasy entities that do not exist in the real world (e.g., dragons, genies, elves, or unicorns), as well as cross-species feature mixtures or invalid species traits (e.g., a cat with a dog-like face).
paragraphs.zh: 对象身份违规：存在虚构或奇幻实体，这些实体在现实世界中并不存在（例如龙、精灵、小精灵或独角兽），以及跨物种的特征混合或无效的物种特征（例如，长着狗脸的猫）。

paragraphs.en: Structural distortion : obvious structural distortions arising from generation failures (e.g., melted-looking objects).
paragraphs.zh: 结构扭曲：由生成失败引起的明显结构扭曲（例如，看起来像融化的物体）。

paragraphs.en: Biological anatomy violations : anatomically impossible features (e.g., a human hand with six fingers or eyes looking in incompatible directions).
paragraphs.zh: 生物学解剖学违规：解剖学上不可能存在的特征（例如，有六根手指的人手，或眼睛朝向不兼容的方向）。

paragraphs.en: Non-biological structure violations : impossible object structures or implausible part configurations (e.g., a bicycle with disconnected wheels or a car with misplaced wheels).
paragraphs.zh: 非生物结构违规：不可能的物体结构或不合理的部件配置（例如，车轮分离的自行车或车轮位置错乱的汽车）。

paragraphs.en: Texture/surface violations : physically implausible textures or material patterns (e.g., skin appearing like stone or wood grain).
paragraphs.zh: 纹理/表面异常：物理上不合理的纹理或材质图案（例如，皮肤看起来像石头或木纹）。

paragraphs.en: Symbolic-content violations : broken, distorted, or unrecognizable text, symbols, signs, logos, or other markings.
paragraphs.zh: 符号内容违规：破损、失真或无法识别的文本、符号、标志、徽标或其他标记。

paragraphs.en: Object-context violations : object-scene combinations that violate common real-world knowledge (e.g., a dog working in an office), or symbolic content inappropriate to its context (e.g., menu text unrelated to food).
paragraphs.zh: 对象-语境违规：指违反现实世界常识的对象与场景组合（例如，一只狗在办公室工作），或与其语境不符的象征性内容（例如，菜单文本与食物无关）。

paragraphs.en: Interaction-level. At the interaction level, the general standard is that objects, agents, and environmental elements should interact in physically plausible ways, with those interactions should be consistent with the depicted action or event. This level focuses on whether contact, force, motion, medium response, and event-dependent behavior are visually coherent. Similarly, for stylized images, we do not penalize simplifications in lighting, motion depiction, or medium-response details, provided they do not break the causal logic of the interaction. We consider eight specific interaction-level violation types:
paragraphs.zh: 交互层面。 在交互层面，通用标准是：物体、智能体和环境元素应以物理上合理的方式相互作用，且这些相互作用应与所描绘的动作或事件保持一致。 这一层面关注的是接触、力、运动、介质响应以及依赖事件的行为是否在视觉上具有连贯性。 同样地，对于风格化的图像，只要简化处理没有破坏交互的因果逻辑，我们不会对光照、运动表现或介质响应细节的简化进行扣分。 我们考虑了八种具体的交互层面违规类型：

sents.en: Interaction-level.
sents.zh: 交互层面。

sents.en: At the interaction level, the general standard is that objects, agents, and environmental elements should interact in physically plausible ways, with those interactions should be consistent with the depicted action or event.
sents.zh: 在交互层面，通用标准是：物体、智能体和环境元素应以物理上合理的方式相互作用，且这些相互作用应与所描绘的动作或事件保持一致。

sents.en: This level focuses on whether contact, force, motion, medium response, and event-dependent behavior are visually coherent.
sents.zh: 这一层面关注的是接触、力、运动、介质响应以及依赖事件的行为是否在视觉上具有连贯性。

sents.en: Similarly, for stylized images, we do not penalize simplifications in lighting, motion depiction, or medium-response details, provided they do not break the causal logic of the interaction.
sents.zh: 同样地，对于风格化的图像，只要简化处理没有破坏交互的因果逻辑，我们不会对光照、运动表现或介质响应细节的简化进行扣分。

sents.en: We consider eight specific interaction-level violation types:
sents.zh: 我们考虑了八种具体的交互层面违规类型：

paragraphs.en: Contact-state violations : physically impossible contact relationships (i.e., object interpenetration).
paragraphs.zh: 接触状态违反：物理上不可能存在的接触关系（即物体相互穿透）。

paragraphs.en: Support and stability violations : implausible hovering or levitation without support, or objects appearing stably at rest despite inadequate support, balance, or friction (e.g., a cup perched on a narrow railing without tipping).
paragraphs.zh: 支撑与稳定性违规：在没有支撑的情况下出现不合理的悬停或漂浮，或者物体在缺乏足够支撑、平衡或摩擦的情况下仍显得稳定静止（例如，一个杯子立在狭窄的栏杆上却没有倾倒）。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic response violations : missing or implausible physical responses under force (e.g., a car driving through a puddle without splash, or motion cues that contradict the implied acceleration, impact, or turning).
paragraphs.zh: 动态响应违规：在受力情况下缺少或不合理的物理响应（例如，汽车驶过水坑时没有溅起水花，或运动提示与所暗示的加速度、撞击或转向相矛盾）。

paragraphs.en: Medium interaction violations : implausible interactions with water, air, snow, sand, or similar media (e.g., incorrect buoyancy, immersion depth, waterline, or air-resistance cues).
paragraphs.zh: 中等程度的交互错误：与水体、空气、雪、沙子或类似介质之间不合理的交互（例如，错误的浮力、浸入深度、水线或空气阻力提示）。

paragraphs.en: Optical effect violations : physically implausible shadows, reflections, or refraction/transmission effects (e.g., a mirror reflection that does not match the reflected object).
paragraphs.zh: 光学效果违规：物理上不合理的阴影、反射或折射/透射效果（例如，与反射物体不匹配的镜面反射）。

paragraphs.en: Energy source violations : visible light, heat, or other energy output without a plausible source or supporting cue (e.g., a glowing light bulb with no wires, socket, or visible power source).
paragraphs.zh: 能源源违规：可见光、热量或其他能量输出，但缺乏合理的来源或支持性线索（例如，一个发光灯泡却没有电线、插座或可见的电源）。

paragraphs.en: Thermal response violations : implausible responses to heat or cold (e.g., an ice cube sitting on a red-hot pan without melting).
paragraphs.zh: 热响应异常：对热或冷的反应不真实（例如，一个冰块放在烧红的煎锅上却未融化）。

paragraphs.en: Behavior-event interaction violations : behaviors that do not match the depicted event (e.g., eyes not tracking the ball during a tennis shot).
paragraphs.zh: 行为-事件交互违规：指与所描绘事件不符的行为（例如，在网球击球过程中眼睛没有追踪球）。

paragraphs.en: Scene-level. At the scene level, the general standard is that the depicted scene should exhibit a coherent global spatial configuration, with scale, depth ordering, and region continuity that are mutually consistent and plausible for a real-world scene. This level captures failures that may not be attributable to any single object, but instead arise from inconsistencies in the global composition of the image. We consider three specific scene-level violation types:
paragraphs.zh: 场景级。 在场景层面，通用标准是所描绘的场景应呈现出连贯的整体空间布局，其尺度、深度排序和区域连续性之间相互一致，并符合真实场景的合理性。 这一层级能够捕捉到那些可能无法归因于任何单个物体，而是源于图像整体构图不一致的问题。 我们考虑三种具体的场景级违规类型：

sents.en: Scene-level.
sents.zh: 场景级。

sents.en: At the scene level, the general standard is that the depicted scene should exhibit a coherent global spatial configuration, with scale, depth ordering, and region continuity that are mutually consistent and plausible for a real-world scene.
sents.zh: 在场景层面，通用标准是所描绘的场景应呈现出连贯的整体空间布局，其尺度、深度排序和区域连续性之间相互一致，并符合真实场景的合理性。

sents.en: This level captures failures that may not be attributable to any single object, but instead arise from inconsistencies in the global composition of the image.
sents.zh: 这一层级能够捕捉到那些可能无法归因于任何单个物体，而是源于图像整体构图不一致的问题。

sents.en: We consider three specific scene-level violation types:
sents.zh: 我们考虑三种具体的场景级违规类型：

paragraphs.en: Relative-scale violations : implausible relative scale between objects and the surrounding scene, or among objects within the scene, which could caused by inconsistent depth or perspective cues (e.g., a distant rider appearing as large as a nearby car).
paragraphs.zh: 相对尺度违背：物体与周围场景之间，或场景内物体之间的相对尺度不协调，可能由不一致的深度或透视线索引起（例如，远处的骑手看起来和近处的汽车一样大）。

paragraphs.en: Depth-order/occlusion violations : implausible occlusion relationships or depth-order inconsistencies (e.g., overlapping elephants with incorrect occlusion that make some legs appear missing or duplicated).
paragraphs.zh: 深度顺序/遮挡违规：不合理的遮挡关系或深度顺序不一致（例如，大象之间出现错误的遮挡重叠，导致某些腿看起来缺失或重复）。

paragraphs.en: Region continuity violations : abrupt or implausible discontinuities between adjacent scene regions (e.g., a desk scene split by an abrupt lighting change).
paragraphs.zh: 区域连续性违规：相邻场景区域之间出现突兀或不合理的断裂（例如，一个桌面场景因突然的照明变化而被分割）。

paragraphs.en: Overall, this three-level formulation allows TerraVis to evaluate world consistency in a structured and interpretable way. Instead of treating inconsistency as a simple binary failure signal, TerraVis decomposes it into violations at the object, interaction, and scene levels, covering 7, 8, and 3 specific violation types, respectively. This design supports finer-grained analysis of model behavior and provides greater insight into the failure modes underlying world-consistency errors.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这种三级框架使 TerraVis 能够以结构化且可解释的方式评估世界一致性。 TerraVis 并未将不一致性视为简单的二元失败信号，而是将其分解为对象、交互和场景层面上的违反行为，分别涵盖 7 种、8 种和 3 种具体的违反类型。 这种设计支持对模型行为的更精细分析，并有助于更深入地理解世界一致性错误背后的失效模式。

paragraphs.en: This prompt is used for severity classification after a world-consistency violation has been detected. Given the violation type, diagnostic question, affected aspect, and visible evidence provided by the previous stage, the classifier determines whether the issue should be treated as a major or minor violation. A violation is classified as major if it affects the main subject, foreground object, depicted action, or another semantically central element; otherwise, it is classified as minor when the affected aspect is peripheral or background-related. This design separates violation detection from severity assessment and encourages the model to judge severity based only on the detected issue and its visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 此提示用于在检测到世界一致性违反后进行分类严重性判断。 基于前一阶段提供的违反类型、诊断问题、受影响方面及可见证据，分类器将决定该问题应被归类为重大违反还是轻微违反。 如果违反行为影响了主要主体、前景物体、所描绘的动作或其他语义核心元素，则被归类为重大违反；否则，若受影响方面属于次要或背景相关，则被归类为轻微违反。 此设计将违反检测与严重性评估分离开来，并促使模型仅根据已检测到的问题及其视觉证据来判断严重性。

paragraphs.en: Similar to common human annotation protocols in text-to-image evaluation [ 36 ] , we ask three independent annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to provide an overall world-consistency rating for each generated image. For five text-to-image models across two benchmarks, this results in 3 × 5 × ( 100 + 800 ) = 13,500 3\times 5\times(100+800)=13{,}500 annotations in total. Annotators are required to be AMT Masters, over 18 years old, and willing to review potentially offensive content. We pay approximately $0.08 for each annotation. Figure A1 shows the interface used for human evaluation. Annotators rate the world consistency of each image on a scale from 1 to 5, with an additional “N/A” option for images outside the scope of world-consistency evaluation. The rating criteria are as follows:

paragraphs.en: To improve inter-annotator agreement (IAA), we additionally include a binary world-consistency question before the 5-point rating, asking annotators to first judge whether the image contains any perceptible world-consistency violation. Our collected human ratings show a high level of inter-rater agreement: Krippendorff’s α \alpha reaches 0.686 and 0.513 on the 5-point world-consistency ratings for COCO-T2I and GenAI-Bench, respectively. For the binary violation labels, annotators achieve Gwet’s AC1 [ 12 ] scores of 0.603 and 0.555 on COCO-T2I and GenAI-Bench, respectively, indicating moderate-to-substantial agreement beyond chance.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提高标注者间一致性（IAA），我们在 5 分制评分之前额外加入了一个二元世界一致性问题，要求标注者首先判断图像中是否存在任何可感知到的世界一致性违反。 我们收集的人类评分显示出高度的一致性：Krippendorff’s α \alpha 在 COCO-T2I 和 GenAI-Bench 的 5 分制世界一致性评分上分别达到了 0.686 和 0.513。 对于二元违反标签，标注者在 COCO-T2I 和 GenAI-Bench 上的 Gwet’s AC1 [ 12 ] 得分分别为 0.603 和 0.555，表明一致性程度高于随机水平，达到中等至显著水平。

paragraphs.en: GPTScore, TerraVis-H, and TerraVis form a progression from generic holistic scoring to task-specific holistic scoring and, finally, structured evaluation. GPTScore uses a generic instruction to produce a holistic score, whereas TerraVis-H uses the full instructions provided to human annotators while retaining holistic scoring. TerraVis further decomposes the assessment into explicit checks and aggregates detected violations according to severity.
paragraphs.zh: GPTScore、TerraVis-H 和 TerraVis 构成了一个从通用整体评分到任务特定整体评分，并最终发展为结构化评估的演进过程。 GPTScore 使用通用指令生成整体评分，而 TerraVis-H 则采用提供给人类标注员的完整指令，同时保留整体评分方式。 TerraVis 进一步将评估分解为明确的检查项，并根据严重程度汇总检测到的违规行为。

paragraphs.en: The improvement from the near-zero correlations of GPTScore to the higher correlations of TerraVis-H suggests that task-specific instructions help align evaluation with human criteria. To examine the additional contribution of structured evaluation, we compare TerraVis-H and TerraVis on image-level world-consistency violation detection. Human reference positives are images judged to contain at least one world-consistency violation by a majority of annotators (at least two of three). Table A1 reports the positive rates for the human reference and both evaluators, together with precision and recall computed against these reference labels.

paragraphs.en: We observe TerraVis-H exhibits a conservative detection pattern as its positive rates are substantially lower than those of the human reference on both benchmarks, with high precision but low recall, while TerraVis achieves 3.37 × 3.37\times and 2.44 × 2.44\times the recall of TerraVis-H on COCO-T2I and GenAI-Bench, respectively. These gains are accompanied by precision decreases of 10.2 10.2 and 4.2 4.2 percentage points, to 75.8 % 75.8\% and 89.1 % 89.1\% , respectively. The low recall of TerraVis-H indicates that even with detailed task instructions, holistic scoring can leave many images containing human-identified violations undetected. TerraVis’s substantially higher recall suggests that decomposing the assessment into explicit checks helps identify more of these images, although at some cost to precision. This improved detection provides a possible explanation for TerraVis’s stronger correlations with human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到 TerraVis-H 表现出保守的检测模式：在两个基准测试中，其阳性率均显著低于人类参考模型，虽然精确度较高但召回率较低；而 TerraVis 在 COCO-T2I 和 GenAI-Bench 上的召回率分别是 TerraVis-H 的 3.37 × 3.37\times 和 2.44 × 2.44\times。 这些提升伴随着精确度的下降，分别降低了 10.2 10.2 和 4.2 4.2 个百分点，降至 75.8 % 75.8\% 和 89.1 % 89.1\%。 TerraVis-H 的低召回率表明，即使有详细的任务说明，整体评分方法仍可能漏检许多包含人类识别出的违规内容的图像。 TerraVis 显著更高的召回率表明，将评估分解为明确的检查步骤有助于识别更多这类图像，尽管这会以部分精确度的下降为代价。 这种检测能力的提升为 TerraVis 与人类判断之间更强的相关性提供了一种可能的解释。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the sensitivity of TerraVis to the aggregation hyperparameters λ \lambda and α \alpha in Eq. ( 1 ) on the COCO-T2I benchmark. Pearson correlation, however, can vary because it is sensitive to nonlinear transformations of the score range. While changing α \alpha adjusts the relative weight of minor violations and can affect the ranking, TerraVis remains stable across a broad range of α \alpha , showing that the aggregation is robust to this hyperparameter choice. As shown in Table A3 , the default setting ( λ = 1 , α = 0.5 ) (\lambda=1,\alpha=0.5) achieves near-optimal correlations with human judgments.

paragraphs.en: Table A4 reports pairwise agreement between T2I model rankings produced by TerraVis using different MLLM evaluators. Mean Kendall’s τ \tau across all ten evaluator pairs is 0.64 on COCO-T2I and 0.68 on GenAI-Bench. Agreement is higher within groups defined by evaluators’ correlations with human judgments. GPT-5.5 and Gemma 4 31B, the two evaluators most closely aligned with human judgments, achieve τ = 0.80 \tau=0.80 on both benchmarks. The remaining three evaluators also agree closely among themselves, with a mean pairwise τ = 0.87 \tau=0.87 on both benchmarks. Between-group agreement is lower, averaging τ = 0.50 \tau=0.50 on COCO-T2I and τ = 0.57 \tau=0.57 on GenAI-Bench. These results support the consistency of TerraVis rankings within each evaluator group, while suggesting that differences in alignment with human judgments may contribute to the remaining ranking variation.

paragraphs.en: Since TerraVis is an image-level, prompt-independent evaluation method, the prompt distribution can influence the distribution of generated images and, consequently, the proportion of detected violations across models. For example, from COCO-T2I to GenAI-Bench, the proportion of object identity violations increases consistently across all five models. paragraphs.en: A key motivation for TerraVis is that existing evaluation dimensions for text-to-image generation capture different aspects of image quality, but do not explicitly measure whether an image remains visually plausible with respect to the real world. In this work, we distinguish four related but fundamentally different concepts: photorealism , faithfulness , aesthetics , and world consistency . Photorealism refers to the extent to which an image visually resembles a natural photograph or real visual observation, emphasizing photographic appearance, texture fidelity, lighting, and perceptual detail. Faithfulness (or text-image alignment) measures whether the generated image semantically matches the conditioning prompt, regardless of whether the depicted content is physically or structurally plausible. Aesthetics evaluates subjective visual appeal, including composition, color harmony, artistic quality, and overall attractiveness to human observers. In contrast, world consistency evaluates whether the depicted objects, interactions, and scenes conform to real-world structural, spatial, biological, and physical constraints. Importantly, these dimensions are neither equivalent nor mutually implied. For example, an image may appear highly realistic and aesthetically pleasing while still containing anatomically impossible hands, inconsistent reflections, or implausible object interactions. Similarly, an image may faithfully follow a prompt describing an impossible event while remaining world-inconsistent. TerraVis therefore treats world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension that is orthogonal to photorealism, aesthetics, and prompt faithfulness, focusing specifically on perceptible violations of real-world plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: TerraVis 的一个核心动机在于：现有文本到图像生成的评估维度虽然涵盖了图像质量的多个不同方面，但并未明确衡量图像在视觉上是否仍符合现实世界的合理性。 在本研究中，我们区分了四个相关但本质上不同的概念：照片级真实感、忠实度、美学性和世界一致性。 照片级真实感指图像在视觉上与真实照片或实际视觉观察的相似程度，强调摄影外观、纹理保真度、光照和感知细节。 忠实度（或文本-图像对齐）衡量生成的图像是否在语义上与条件提示相匹配，而不论其描绘的内容在物理或结构上是否合理。 美学性评估主观的视觉吸引力，包括构图、色彩和谐、艺术品质以及对人类观察者的整体吸引力。 相比之下，世界一致性评估所描绘的对象、互动和场景是否符合现实世界的结构、空间、生物和物理约束。 重要的是，这些维度既不等价，也不相互蕴含。 例如，一张图像可能看起来高度真实且富有美感，但仍包含解剖学上不可能的手部结构、不一致的反射或不合逻辑的对象互动。 同样地，一张图像可能忠实遵循描述了一个不可能事件的提示，但本身仍与世界一致性不符。 因此，TerraVis 将世界一致性视为一个补充性的评估维度，它与照片级真实感、美学性和提示忠实度相互独立，并专门关注可感知到的现实合理性违背。

sents.zh: 相比之下，世界一致性评估所描绘的对象、互动和场景是否符合现实世界的结构、空间、生物和物理约束。

sents.en: Importantly, these dimensions are neither equivalent nor mutually implied.
sents.zh: 重要的是，这些维度既不等价，也不相互蕴含。

sents.en: For example, an image may appear highly realistic and aesthetically pleasing while still containing anatomically impossible hands, inconsistent reflections, or implausible object interactions.
sents.zh: 例如，一张图像可能看起来高度真实且富有美感，但仍包含解剖学上不可能的手部结构、不一致的反射或不合逻辑的对象互动。

sents.en: Similarly, an image may faithfully follow a prompt describing an impossible event while remaining world-inconsistent.
sents.zh: 同样地，一张图像可能忠实遵循描述了一个不可能事件的提示，但本身仍与世界一致性不符。

sents.en: TerraVis therefore treats world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension that is orthogonal to photorealism, aesthetics, and prompt faithfulness, focusing specifically on perceptible violations of real-world plausibility.
sents.zh: 因此，TerraVis 将世界一致性视为一个补充性的评估维度，它与照片级真实感、美学性和提示忠实度相互独立，并专门关注可感知到的现实合理性违背。

paragraphs.en: We provide more examples of four patterns of disagreement in world-consistency evaluation, as shown in A3 . We observe that TerraVis can perform well in stylized images, such as the first example in Human Oversights, where human raters fail to find the failures that the the mice stand calmly next to the cat instead of fleeing or showing fear despite being beside a predator, which is a behavior-event violation. Also TerraVis can miss violations in stylized images, such as the first example in Missed Violations, where several lanterns appear to float below the branches without visible support, a support violation overlooked by TerraVis. Furthermore, Figures A4 , A5 , A6 illustrate the differences between existing evaluation metrics, including text-image alignment, human preference, and artifact detection (i.e., RAHF), and world consistency evaluation. We summarize three key findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了世界一致性评估中四种不一致模式的更多示例，如 A3 所示。 我们观察到 TerraVis 在风格化图像中的表现良好，例如“人类疏漏”部分中的第一个示例：人类评分者未能发现错误——尽管老鼠身处捕食者身旁，它们却平静地站在猫旁边，而非逃跑或表现出恐惧，这属于行为-事件违反。 此外，TerraVis 也可能在风格化图像中遗漏违反情况，例如“被忽略的违反”部分中的第一个示例：几个灯笼似乎漂浮在树枝下方且没有可见的支撑，这一支撑违反被 TerraVis 忽略了。 此外，图 A4、A5 和 A6 展示了现有评估指标（包括文本-图像对齐、人类偏好和人工产物检测（即 RAHF））与世界一致性评估之间的差异。 我们总结了三个关键发现。

sents.en: We provide more examples of four patterns of disagreement in world-consistency evaluation, as shown in A3 .
sents.zh: 我们提供了世界一致性评估中四种不一致模式的更多示例，如 A3 所示。

sents.en: We observe that TerraVis can perform well in stylized images, such as the first example in Human Oversights, where human raters fail to find the failures that the the mice stand calmly next to the cat instead of fleeing or showing fear despite being beside a predator, which is a behavior-event violation.
sents.zh: 我们观察到 TerraVis 在风格化图像中的表现良好，例如“人类疏漏”部分中的第一个示例：人类评分者未能发现错误——尽管老鼠身处捕食者身旁，它们却平静地站在猫旁边，而非逃跑或表现出恐惧，这属于行为-事件违反。

sents.en: Also TerraVis can miss violations in stylized images, such as the first example in Missed Violations, where several lanterns appear to float below the branches without visible support, a support violation overlooked by TerraVis.
sents.zh: 此外，TerraVis 也可能在风格化图像中遗漏违反情况，例如“被忽略的违反”部分中的第一个示例：几个灯笼似乎漂浮在树枝下方且没有可见的支撑，这一支撑违反被 TerraVis 忽略了。

sents.en: Furthermore, Figures A4 , A5 , A6 illustrate the differences between existing evaluation metrics, including text-image alignment, human preference, and artifact detection (i.e., RAHF), and world consistency evaluation.
sents.zh: 此外，图 A4、A5 和 A6 展示了现有评估指标（包括文本-图像对齐、人类偏好和人工产物检测（即 RAHF））与世界一致性评估之间的差异。

sents.en: We summarize three key findings.
sents.zh: 我们总结了三个关键发现。

paragraphs.en: First, prompt faithfulness and world consistency capture distinct dimensions . Prompt alignment measures how faithfully an image reflects the content specified in the prompt, even when that content itself is implausible in the real-world. In contrast, world consistency evaluates whether the generated image conforms to real-world constraints. Therefore, a high degree of prompt faithfulness does not necessarily imply high world consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，提示忠实度和世界一致性分别捕捉了不同的维度。 提示对齐衡量的是图像对提示中所指定内容的忠实程度，即使该内容在现实世界中本身并不合理。 相比之下，世界一致性评估的是生成的图像是否符合现实世界的约束条件。 因此，高度的提示忠实度并不必然意味着高度的世界一致性。

sents.en: First, prompt faithfulness and world consistency capture distinct dimensions .
sents.zh: 首先，提示忠实度和世界一致性分别捕捉了不同的维度。

sents.en: Prompt alignment measures how faithfully an image reflects the content specified in the prompt, even when that content itself is implausible in the real-world.
sents.zh: 提示对齐衡量的是图像对提示中所指定内容的忠实程度，即使该内容在现实世界中本身并不合理。

sents.en: In contrast, world consistency evaluates whether the generated image conforms to real-world constraints.
sents.zh: 相比之下，世界一致性评估的是生成的图像是否符合现实世界的约束条件。

sents.en: Therefore, a high degree of prompt faithfulness does not necessarily imply high world consistency.
sents.zh: 因此，高度的提示忠实度并不必然意味着高度的世界一致性。

paragraphs.en: Second, HPSv3 primarily captures aesthetic preference rather than world consistency . Its preference-oriented evaluation can correlate with perceived visual quality, but does not explicitly assess whether the depicted content is consistent with real-world knowledge or physical plausibility.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，HPSv3 主要捕捉的是审美偏好，而非世界一致性。 其以偏好为导向的评估可能与感知到的视觉质量相关，但并未明确判断所描绘的内容是否与真实世界的知识或物理合理性一致。

sents.en: Second, HPSv3 primarily captures aesthetic preference rather than world consistency .
sents.zh: 其次，HPSv3 主要捕捉的是审美偏好，而非世界一致性。

sents.en: Its preference-oriented evaluation can correlate with perceived visual quality, but does not explicitly assess whether the depicted content is consistent with real-world knowledge or physical plausibility.
sents.zh: 其以偏好为导向的评估可能与感知到的视觉质量相关，但并未明确判断所描绘的内容是否与真实世界的知识或物理合理性一致。

paragraphs.en: Third, RAHF is primarily designed to detect rendering artifacts, and its coverage of world consistency is therefore limited . In particular, its plausibility head was trained to detect artifacts using RichHF-18K [ 26 ] , which constrains its coverage to the types of artifacts represented in the training data. Consequently, it may not fully capture novel forms of artifacts arising from newer text-to-image models, such as Nano Banana Pro.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，RAHF 主要设计用于检测渲染伪影，因此其对世界一致性的覆盖范围有限。 具体而言，其合理性头是使用 RichHF-18K [26] 训练来检测伪影的，这使其覆盖范围局限于训练数据中所包含的伪影类型。 因此，它可能无法完全捕捉到由较新的文本到图像模型（如 Nano Banana Pro）产生的新型伪影形式。

sents.en: Third, RAHF is primarily designed to detect rendering artifacts, and its coverage of world consistency is therefore limited .
sents.zh: 第三，RAHF 主要设计用于检测渲染伪影，因此其对世界一致性的覆盖范围有限。

sents.en: In particular, its plausibility head was trained to detect artifacts using RichHF-18K [ 26 ] , which constrains its coverage to the types of artifacts represented in the training data.
sents.zh: 具体而言，其合理性头是使用 RichHF-18K [26] 训练来检测伪影的，这使其覆盖范围局限于训练数据中所包含的伪影类型。

sents.en: Consequently, it may not fully capture novel forms of artifacts arising from newer text-to-image models, such as Nano Banana Pro.
sents.zh: 因此，它可能无法完全捕捉到由较新的文本到图像模型（如 Nano Banana Pro）产生的新型伪影形式。

paragraphs.en: (a) Human Oversights TerraVis identifies genuine violations that are overlooked by human evaluators
paragraphs.zh: (a) 人类疏忽 TerraVis 能够识别出人类评估者所忽略的真实违规行为

paragraphs.en: Evidence: the mice stand calmly next to the cat instead of fleeing or showing fear despite being beside a predator.
paragraphs.zh: 证据：尽管身处捕食者身旁，这些小鼠却安然站立在猫旁边，并未逃跑或表现出恐惧。

paragraphs.en: Affected aspect: time label on dumbbell.
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的方面：哑铃上的时间标签。

paragraphs.en: Evidence: the dumbbell has the text “17:35” printed on it, which resembles a time rather than an appropriate weight marking.
paragraphs.zh: 证据：哑铃上印有“17:35”字样，这看起来更像是一个时间，而非合适的重量标记。

paragraphs.en: (b) False Positives TerraVis produces false-positive violations that are not recognized by human evaluators
paragraphs.zh: (b) 误报 TerraVis 会产生人类评估者未能识别出的误报违规行为

paragraphs.en: Affected aspect: metallic chair on the right.
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的方面：右侧的金属椅子。

paragraphs.en: Evidence: the metallic chair appears poorly integrated with the stone path, with mismatched reflections and weak contact alignment at its base compared to the surrounding scene.
paragraphs.zh: 证据：这张金属椅子似乎与石质小径结合得并不协调，其底部的反射效果与周围环境不匹配，且接触对齐度较弱。

paragraphs.en: Other detected types: structural distortion, non-biological structure, and contact state.
paragraphs.zh: 其他检测到的类型：结构扭曲、非生物结构和接触状态。

paragraphs.en: Affected aspect: daisies on the girl’s hair.
paragraphs.zh: 受影响的方面：女孩头发上的雏菊。

paragraphs.en: Evidence: the flowers appear pasted onto the dark hair with little to no contact shadow beneath the petals, making the interaction look physically implausible.
paragraphs.zh: 证据：这些花朵看起来像是粘贴在深色头发上的，花瓣下方几乎没有接触阴影，使得这种互动在物理上显得不真实。

paragraphs.en: Other detected types: region continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 其他检测到的类型：区域连续性。

paragraphs.en: (c) Missed Violations TerraVis misses genuine violations identified by human evaluators
paragraphs.zh: (c) 漏检违规行为 TerraVis 未能检测到人类评估员识别出的真实违规行为

paragraphs.en: Disagreement: : TerraVis detects no violations and assigns the maximum world-consistency score of 1.0, whereas all three human raters assign the lowest rating (1/5). Our manual review confirms that several lanterns appear to float below the branches without visible support, a support violation overlooked by TerraVis.
paragraphs.zh: 分歧：TerraVis 未检测到任何违规行为，并给出了最高的世界一致性分数 1.0，而三位人类评分者均给出了最低评分（1/5）。 我们的手动审查证实，有几盏灯笼似乎漂浮在树枝下方且没有可见的支撑，这一支撑违规行为被 TerraVis 忽略了。

sents.en: Disagreement: : TerraVis detects no violations and assigns the maximum world-consistency score of 1.0, whereas all three human raters assign the lowest rating (1/5).
sents.zh: 分歧：TerraVis 未检测到任何违规行为，并给出了最高的世界一致性分数 1.0，而三位人类评分者均给出了最低评分（1/5）。

sents.en: Our manual review confirms that several lanterns appear to float below the branches without visible support, a support violation overlooked by TerraVis.
sents.zh: 我们的手动审查证实，有几盏灯笼似乎漂浮在树枝下方且没有可见的支撑，这一支撑违规行为被 TerraVis 忽略了。

paragraphs.en: Disagreement: TerraVis detects no violations, whereas human raters assign low world-consistency ratings. Our manual review identifies apparent anatomical distortions in the rabbit’s lower limbs, with poorly defined paws that appear fused with the body, a anatomy violation overlooked by TerraVis.
paragraphs.zh: 分歧：TerraVis 未检测到任何违规行为，而人类评分者则给出了较低的世界一致性评分。 我们的手动审查发现兔子的下肢存在明显的人体解剖结构扭曲，其爪子轮廓模糊，看起来与身体融合在一起，这是一处 TerraVis 未能识别出的解剖结构违规行为。

sents.en: Disagreement: TerraVis detects no violations, whereas human raters assign low world-consistency ratings.
sents.zh: 分歧：TerraVis 未检测到任何违规行为，而人类评分者则给出了较低的世界一致性评分。

sents.en: Our manual review identifies apparent anatomical distortions in the rabbit’s lower limbs, with poorly defined paws that appear fused with the body, a anatomy violation overlooked by TerraVis.
sents.zh: 我们的手动审查发现兔子的下肢存在明显的人体解剖结构扭曲，其爪子轮廓模糊，看起来与身体融合在一起，这是一处 TerraVis 未能识别出的解剖结构违规行为。

paragraphs.en: (d) Rater Disagreement Human evaluators have inconsistent judgments on the presence or severity of violations
paragraphs.zh: (d) 评分者分歧：人类评估者对违规行为的有无或严重程度存在不一致的判断。

paragraphs.en: Disagreement: Ratings span from 2 to 5 for the same image, indicating substantial inter-rater disagreement.
paragraphs.zh: 分歧：同一张图片的评分范围从 2 到 5，表明评分者之间存在显著分歧。

paragraphs.en: (a) High Alignment but Low Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (a) 高度对齐但人类世界一致性得分较低

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A large group of people on a couple boats in the water.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一大群人乘坐几艘小船漂浮在水面上。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The crowd includes fused arms, although the depicted people, boats, and water match the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：人群包含了融合的手臂，尽管所描绘的人物、船只和水面与提示相符。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A computer desk topped with a desktop computer and a laptop.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一张电脑桌上放着一台台式电脑和一台笔记本电脑。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The laptop has a distorted, melted appearance despite the correct desk and computer content.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管桌面和计算机的内容是正确的，但笔记本电脑呈现出扭曲、融化的外观。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: Ancient buildings juxtaposed with sleek, futuristic transports.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：古老的建筑与流畅的未来主义交通工具并置。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The requested juxtaposition receives high alignment scores, while both world-consistency assessments are low.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：所请求的并置获得了较高的对齐分数，而两项世界一致性评估的分数均较低。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The action matches the prompt, but the boy’s left hand has distorted fingers.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：该动作与提示相符，但男孩的左手手指出现了扭曲。

paragraphs.en: (b) Low Alignment but High Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (b) 对齐度低但人类世界一致性得分高

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Jealousy is not clearly conveyed; the people themselves appear visually plausible.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：嫉妒之情并未清晰传达；人物本身在视觉上看起来可信。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A field without a single blade of grass.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一片连一棵草都没有的田野。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Grass remains visible despite the negation in the prompt; its presence is physically plausible.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管提示词中存在否定表述，草地仍然可见；其存在在物理上是合理的。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A bed with no pillows, only a folded blanket.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一张没有枕头的床，只有一床折叠好的毯子。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The visible pillow contradicts the prompt, while the bedroom remains world consistent.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：可见的枕头与提示相矛盾，而卧室仍然与世界保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A fountain with no water flowing.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一个没有水流出的喷泉。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Water flows despite the prompt requesting none; the depicted fountain remains physically plausible.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管提示词要求水不要流动，但水仍然在流动；所描绘的喷泉在物理上仍然是合理的。

paragraphs.en: (a) High HPSv3 but Low Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (a) HPSv3 得分高，但人类世界一致性得分低

paragraphs.en: Prompt: The wooden boardwalk along the beach is lined with shops.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：沿着海滩的木制步道两旁排列着商店。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The detailed boardwalk receives a high preference score, while TerraVis and all three raters give lower world-consistency scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：详细的木板步道获得了较高的偏好分数，而 TerraVis 和所有三名评分者给出的世界一致性分数则较低。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: An ancient library hidden beneath the earth, ‘Secrets of the Ages’ inscribed on the archway, books floating around as if by magic.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一座藏于地下的古老图书馆，拱门上刻有“时代之谜”的字样，书籍仿佛被魔法般悬浮四周。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Books float without visible support in an otherwise richly detailed, dramatically lit library.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：在一座细节丰富、光线戏剧化的图书馆中，书籍在没有明显支撑的情况下漂浮着。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A robot and a dinosaur play chess in a post-apocalyptic landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：在一处末日后的景观中，一个机器人和一只恐龙正在下棋。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The polished fantasy scene receives a high preference score despite its implausible participants and interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管参与者与互动显得不合常理，但这一精心打磨的奇幻场景仍获得了较高的偏好分数。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A fairy garden at twilight, ‘Whispering Glade’ spelled out in luminescent flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：黄昏时分的仙女花园，用发光的花朵拼出“Whispering Glade”字样。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Glowing floral lettering and miniature fantasy dwellings receive a high preference score but low world-consistency scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：发光的鲜花字母和微型奇幻居所获得了较高的偏好分数，但世界一致性分数较低。

paragraphs.en: (b) Low HPSv3 but High Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (b) HPSv3 得分低，但人类世界一致性得分高

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A mirror without a reflection of light.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一面没有光线反射的镜子。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The sparse composition receives a low preference score, while TerraVis and all raters assign maximum scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：稀疏构图获得的偏好分数较低，而 TerraVis 和所有评分者均给出了最高分。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The cloud contradicts the prompt but is physically plausible; preference and world-consistency scores diverge.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：该云与提示相矛盾，但在物理上是合理的；偏好分与世界一致性得分出现分歧。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A cozy bedroom without a fluffy pillow on the bed.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一间舒适的卧室，床上没有蓬松的枕头。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The pillow contradicts the prompt but remains physically plausible; the preference score is low.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：这个枕头与提示相矛盾，但在物理上仍然合理；偏好得分较低。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A blackboard displays two curves; the pink one undulates more than the white one.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一块黑板上显示着两条曲线；粉色曲线的波动比白色曲线更大。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Humans give maximum ratings; TerraVis marks the graph as out of scope and returns N/A.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：人类给出最高评分；TerraVis 则将该图标记为超出范围，并返回 N/A。

paragraphs.en: (a) High RAHF but Low Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (a) RAHF 高但人类世界一致性得分低

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A swan with a silver anklet on a crystal lake.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一只天鹅，脚上戴着银质脚链，身处一片水晶般的湖泊中。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The lake surface mixes water and crystal-like solids, while the requested anklet is placed around the neck.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：湖面将水与晶体状的固体混合在一起，而所请求的脚链则被戴在脖子上。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: In a mysterious forest, the leaves of a green tree shimmer with a silvery glow, contrasting the dim leaves of a nearby red tree.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：在一片神秘的森林中，一棵绿树的叶子闪烁着银色的光芒，与附近一棵红树的暗淡叶子形成鲜明对比。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The tree appears to emit a silvery glow despite its high RAHF plausibility score.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管该树的 RAHF 可信度得分很高，但它似乎会发出银色的光芒。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: An owl with a tiny book in a moonlit library.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一只猫头鹰在月光下的图书馆里拿着一本小书。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The owl appears to read a glowing book amid floating lights, despite high RAHF scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管 RAHF 分数很高，这只猫头鹰似乎仍在漂浮的灯光中阅读一本发光的书。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: A smiling sloth wearing a bowtie and holding a book.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：一只戴着领结、手里拿着一本书的微笑着的树懒。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The sloth has a human-like smile and holds a book; the stylized scene receives high RAHF scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：这只树懒有着类似人类的笑容，并拿着一本书；这个风格化的场景获得了较高的 RAHF 分数。

paragraphs.en: (b) Low RAHF but High Human World-Consistency Scores
paragraphs.zh: (b) RAHF 较低但人类世界一致性得分较高

paragraphs.en: Prompt: Under the bench, there are four pairs of sneakers: one pair is red, two pairs are green, and the last pair is white.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：长凳下面有四双运动鞋：一双是红色的，两双是绿色的，最后一双是白色的。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The visible shoes and bench appear plausible; TerraVis and all human raters assign maximum scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：可见的鞋子和长凳看起来合情合理；TerraVis 和所有人类评分者都给出了最高分。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: In the forest, there’s a pack of wolves, all of them gray.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：在森林里，有一群狼，它们全都是灰色的。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The wolves appear plausible in their forest setting, despite a low RAHF plausibility score.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管 RAHF 合理性得分较低，但狼群在森林环境中的表现看起来仍然可信。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: The larger person wears blue and the smaller person does not.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：体型较大的人穿着蓝色衣服，而体型较小的人则没有。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: The two people and their contact appear plausible, despite the low RAHF plausibility score.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管 RAHF 可信度得分较低，但这两个人及其联系方式看起来是合理的。

paragraphs.en: Prompt: Two girls sitting on a bed eating bananas together.
paragraphs.zh: 提示：两个女孩坐在床上一起吃香蕉。

paragraphs.en: Discussion: Both people and their interaction appear plausible, despite low RAHF plausibility and aesthetics scores.
paragraphs.zh: 讨论：尽管 RAHF 的合理性得分和美学得分较低，但人物及其互动都显得合情合理。
